# Example React Docs

> Documentation for a small React-like library, indexed for LLM consumption.

## Reference

- [memo](/reference/memo.html): Skip re-rendering when props are unchanged
- [useMemo](/reference/use-memo.md): Cache the result of a calculation between renders
- [Pfeile](/reference/unicode.html): Non-ASCII text handling

## Other

- [Secret](/private/secret.html): Internal page that robots.txt disallows
- [Missing](/missing.html): A page that no longer exists
